The Namco Sub-Board (see Figure 3) is used to expand the memory capacity of the Nintendo MDS pcb. The Sub-Board contains a 4 position dip-switch that configures the pcb for the specific memory chips (Eproms or Ros) used for a particular game. If the switches on the Sub-Board are not set properly, the gase will not operate. Table 2 outlines the various memory devices that can be utilized by the Sub-Board, and the proper switch settings for each configuration. The device numbers in the table are abbreviated. For example, 64 in the table would be a 2764 Eprom or an equivalent memory device.
